description: Reconcile the official OpenAI docs surface against ReqLlmNext and capture an explicit inventory of supported, partial, missing, and boundary-evaluation surfaces. Keep Anthropic standalone media operations unsupported and document that boundary clearly.

comments.text: Initial research pass complete. Current implementation is strong on chat/Responses/embeddings/media basics, but gaps remain in image edits, audio translations and richer diarization normalization, file upload/vector-store utilities, full built-in tool lifecycle coverage, background mode, Batch API, Realtime as a first-class protocol family, and explicit evaluation of MCP/connectors/Skills surfaces. Anthropic boundary remains unchanged: standalone media operations stay unsupported there.

title: Finalize OpenAI gap map and package boundary
